about: F6-style claims fixtures for the Create claims gate (architecture §13.1 F6, §13.2 'Unsupported claims caught: >= 95% recall'; issue #93). Synthetic: written for this PR, not labelled by the owner. Synthetic errors (changed numbers, invented customers, upgraded nouns, superlatives, guarantees, prices) are reported separately from real-draft fixtures, which do not exist yet (§13.1: F6 is mostly real drafts, labelled by hand). Each item: the usable facts, a post, the claims its writer declared, the claims level, and whether the post's claims are all supported. Rule change on PR #99 review: a declared claim is one whole sentence of the post. Under that rule the earlier fixtures s1, s2 and s5, which declared part of a sentence, were refused (3 of 8 supported items flagged); they now declare whole sentences, as the drafting prompt asks.
